title: Bucky Irving returns to Bucs practice, Emeka Egbuka is still out

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucky Irving returns to Bucs practice, Emeka Egbuka is still out
sources.description: Baker Mayfield appears to be on track to make his return to the Buccaneers lineup in Week 7 and it looks like running back Bucky Irving is moving in the same direction.
